description: Hook family library (Master Build §18). Distinct from the conversion hook_categories — these serve Engine B (Audience Value) and Engine C (Brand).

curiosity.description: Open a knowledge gap the reader now wants to close.

knowledge_gap.description: Name a gap between what the reader thinks they know and reality.

question.description: Ask a real, useful question the reader wants answered.

scenario.description: Paint a concrete situation the reader recognizes.
example_starters: It's 2 a.m. and the power just went out.
You reach for your phone at 3%.

example_starters: The bigger power bank isn't always
Cold weather doesn't kill batteries — cold storage does.

direct_value.description: State the benefit up front, no wind-up.

mistake.description: Name a specific mistake the reader might be making.

example_starters: A hot car does more to a lithium battery than

observation.description: Notice something the reader hasn't but immediately recognizes.
example_starters: Every long outage has the same first-hour pattern.

comparison.description: Set up a direct comparison the reader wants resolved.
example_starters: LFP vs NMC in one line:
Fast charging vs slow charging over 500 cycles:

pattern_interrupt.description: Break the reader's scroll rhythm with an unexpected framing.

challenge.description: Invite the reader to test something themselves.
example_starters: Try this the next time your phone hits 20%.
Look at the label on your charger.
